question: What does the dirty-mode refusal protect, and can the ADD88 mode and color fold be consumed without allocating or dropping state that stays valid for the later readers?

scope.control: C=word(G+0x2954), distinct from color-info F=word(G+0x2884) and encoder base G+0x2880.
scope.metadata: Pbase=PS+word(PS+0x40); selected PS metadata MP=Pbase+0x28. Bare object offsets and masks are hexadecimal; counts and stack and frame sizes are decimal.
scope.dirty: D is the full 64-bit returned dirty register, not an ADD88 store to G+0x10; M=1<<56.
scope.qualification: Known writers and complete direct guarded store order, with named open questions in transitive code; the full set of aliases is not covered, and no additional consume is allowed.

dependencies.use: Defines the shared entry and variant, metadata, dirty-producer, and fetch and cache boundaries.
Defines the control, color and dirty readers, whose state stays valid for the later readers, and the pointer-alias qualifications.
Defines persistent bytes, ordered generation history and later Original coherence.
Defines metadata and command pressure, allocator and ordered later dirty-group effects.

orderedFold: Prologue and frame setup and stack+92/+88/+84=-1 precede optional AC6C8 for D&20000. That helper can alter G2940 lowbits, G2ABD04, command bytes and G30 and flush through C588; its returned D OR100 becomes D0. NullVS then returns D0 without shader work.

LiveVS with nullPS and C&7!=5: D adds 80000@ADE44; C=(C&~7) OR5@ADE4C; D adds 8@ADE50; if G2ABF&8, D adds M@ADE68 then F=F&FFF0FFFF@ADE6C. Already 5 skips all those effects. The new 80000 forces the later fetch group even if initially clean.

LivePS always stores G2ABE sticky 08@ADEE4: old 08 OR 8 iff unsigned(load32(Pbase+0x30)&70000000)>10000000. The same input is MP+0x8; zero and 10000000 do not set it. If D0&100000, first ADB98@ADEF8, possible C588@ADF10, add 4000@ADF18, three PS command words@ADF1C/ADF4C/ADF60,G30@ADF6C,G2928@ADF78. Only then, if C&7!=4, add 80000 and 8@ADF88/ADF90, C low 3 bits = 4@ADF98, and under G2ABF&8 add M@ADFAC and F=wholewordRT0+1C@ADFB4. Without dirty 100000, mode 4 is not forced.

Selected flags can call KeBugCheck245 before normal tail work. Z and local control may cache L in G319C@AE060 and derive temporary colorQ with zero nibble when L&7==5; neither replaces persistent C and F. Stack+80@AE00C is a separate metadata intermediate.

The shared fetch path can call ADB98 and clear G2ABE40@AE0D0 or AE1B8, ADC48 persistent or ADA38 allocated-copy routes, and a possible second variant 1@AE168 which can set G2ABE40@AE180. Cache hits still copy G30F0/+30F8 to G2E38/+2E40. Persistent patch and history, copy, allocator and cache, and metadata boundaries remain real effects.

If resulting D&180000, add 10000, store G2924@AE20C, add 8000, store G2920@AE21C from selected metadata. These words stay valid for the later readers: Clear and Resolve and later register runs. The non-Z tail can C588, writes three VS command words@AE55C/AE594/AE5A8, stamps record+40@AE5B0 and publishes G30@AE5B4, then returns full64D.

Z tail can C588; base packet stores@AE288/AE29C/AE2A0/AE2A8; D&8 packet@AE2B8/AE2C4 and clear 8@AE2C0; changed-L packet@AE2E0/E4/E8; D&M packet@AE308/AE318 and clearM@AE314; temporary-Q packet@AE334/338/33C; D&10000 packet@AE35C/368/370 and clear 18000@AE364; alternate derived packet@AE38C/390/394/398. Alternate and primary code packets and stamps follow@AE3BC..AE508 under selected variant guards. Final four words@AE510/520/524/52C precede G30@AE530. Returned dirty transforms do not store to G10.

replacementObligations: Scalar C, F and full64D arithmetic requires no allocation: preserve upperC, exact nibble-clear versus wholeword-copy guards, sticky 08 unsigned predicate and ordered additions. It is not an exact ADD88 replacement by itself.

A no-allocation consume needs every reached metadata, command, stamp, dirty and ABI effect proved equivalent, a compatible fetch hit or proved no-patch path, exact G2928/G2924/G2920 and local-control flags, command capacity and later caller clearing. Earlier PS metadata and command effects precede C and F stores and cannot be moved across unknown aliases.

Refuse before writes on recorded or unsupported Z or alternate paths, bugcheck, import, metadata or pointer bounds, fetch miss, busy or inline without complete history and allocator model, command pressure or unmodeled C588/C270, unknown alias, frame or caller-live parity, state races or service or root lifetime. Current key equality alone does not establish that C*(t) stays valid, or future Original coherence.
guards: Known writer syntax is not an exhaustive all-alias store proof; direct-reader absence does not license dropping C, F or G319C.
Returned dirty masks are not ADD88 writes to G10. Z-tail clears, local mode and temporary color are separate from persistent control and color stores.
No additional dirty-mode consume is allowed; runtime state and frequency were not observed.
conclusion: The mode, control and color fold can be computed exactly, but it triggers shared metadata and fetch effects and command and shadow effects whose state stays valid for the later readers. Replaying only the scalar calculation cannot remove dirty-mode Original work. Consuming that work still requires the complete selected path and its unresolved reader, allocator and history boundaries.
